title: Yellowed Light Thai White Cornmeal Tom Kha
description: A rich and light Thai dish featuring white cornmeal and shio-koji-cure, served in an agave leaf vessel, this tom kha is a festive and diabetic-friendly option.
instructions: Start by curing the chicken breast with shio-koji for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pot, combine the coconut milk, lemon grass, galangal, and lime leaves, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and add the cured chicken breast, cooking until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce and a splash of the coconut milk, then stir the mixture back into the pot.
Stir in the white cornmeal and cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
To serve, spoon the tom kha into agave leaves and garnish with additional lime leaves if desired.
